meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码提交与改动内容做成一段可分享的讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把 PR 里的改动讲给同事、用户或社区听,却不想自己录屏剪辑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change into a narrated explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain code changes on video but don't want to record and edit.

howto.what: 你把一个 GitHub PR(链接、owner/repo#N,或已检出仓库里的 this PR)交给它,它会读取 diff、提交和改动文件,规划分镜,逐帧生成一支代码变更讲解视频,最后渲染成 MP4。
howto.when: 当你给它一个 GitHub PR——PR 链接、owner/repo#N,或已检出仓库里的 “this PR”——时接管。产品宣传或无 PR 的主题讲解会先转到 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把 acme/sdk#1842 这个 PR 做成讲解视频
say.note: 它会拉取 diff 与提交,先给出分镜方案。

say.text: 用 this PR 生成一支重构讲解视频
say.note: 在已检出仓库里直接读取当前 PR。

say.text: 给这个 PR 做一支功能发布讲解视频
say.note: 时长按 PR 规模确定。

howto.what_en: Point it at a GitHub PR (a URL, owner/repo#N, or "this PR" in a checked-out repo): it reads the diff, commits, and changed files, plans a code-change explainer, builds it frame by frame, and renders an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the input is a GitHub pull request — a PR URL, an owner/repo#N ref, or "this PR" in a checked-out repo. Product promos or no-PR topic explainers go to /hyperframes instead.

say_en.text: Make acme/sdk#1842 into a code-change explainer video
say_en.note: It fetches the diff and commits, then proposes a storyboard.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into a refactor walkthrough video
say_en.note: Reads the current PR from the checked-out repo.

say_en.text: Make a feature-reveal video for this PR
